function: Excluded (function): the learned method performs anti-jamming, i.e. SINR maximisation against K jammers by receive beamforming plus movable-antenna positioning (p. 1: "enhancing anti-jamming communication"; p. 2: problem (3)).
notes: Read all 6 pages. Reason code function, first that applies (the work is a research article, proposes a method, has a learned MLP, acts at the physical layer, and reports simulation results). Anti-jamming is named as an excluded function in Step 1. The paper frames itself as jamming mitigation (p. 1: "jointly optimizing the receive beamforming and antenna element positioning" to maximise SINR). The receive beamformer is not learned: it is the closed-form generalized Rayleigh quotient solution (p. 3: "w* = B^-1 a(x,theta0) / ||B^-1 a(x,theta0)||"). The MLP only learns antenna positions from the directions of arrival (p. 3: "we adopt a deep neural network to learn the complicated relationship between the known directions of arrival and the desired antenna element positions"), which is array geometry, not a base station precoder, beams of a communication link, or RIS phase shifts. Setting: single-antenna legitimate source, base station with 8 movable antennas, 3 jammers, field-response channel from directions of arrival only, no RIS (p. 2, p. 4). The PDF is the arXiv version 2 (4 Apr 2025) of 'Deep Learning-Assisted Jamming Mitigation with Movable Antenna Array' and matches a TVT 2025 paper; I could not check the DOI against the title with the allowed files.
